name: Towa no Yakata
source:
19th century. Main character studies at a university abroad, but now for the first returns home for spring vacation. There he stumbles at his mother's diary saying among other things about a mysterious man "There is no way I can keep doing this ..."

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-july-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
19世纪。主人公在海外一所大学求学，如今第一次回乡度春假。他偶然读到母亲的日记，其中提及一位神秘男子，还写着“我不可能再这样继续下去了…”

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-july-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
